table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Date = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	END, 101) AS DATETIME),
	itemname = item.name, 
	Packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
	manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
	looseqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
	price = max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice),    
	ID = MAX(dbo.saledetail.RowId),
	cumulativesum = round(0.0000,2),
	cumulativesumfoot = round(0.0000,2)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,
	dbo.item,
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Accounts,
	dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	END between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
Group by 
	CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
			 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
		END, 101) AS DATETIME),	dbo.saledetail.icode,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.manufacturer.name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Date = CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	END, 101) AS DATETIME),
	itemname = item.name, 
	Packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
	manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
	looseqty = Sum (saledetail.looseqty),
	price = max(saledetail.saleprice),    
	ID = MAX(saledetail.RowId),
	cumulativesum = round(0.0000,2),
	cumulativesumfoot = round(0.0000,2)
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	saleinvdetail saledetail,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Accounts,
	dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	END between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
	dbo.saleledger.ImpactInventory='N' AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	saledetail.icode = item.icode AND 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
Group by 
	CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
			 When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			 When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			 When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
		END, 101) AS DATETIME),
	saledetail.icode,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.manufacturer.name
